pages.title: Reaching Level 30
pages.text: Place fifteen Bookshelves around your Enchanting Table to reach level 30. Leave the space between the shelves and table clear.$(br2)For machine production, a GregTech assembler combines six planks and three books into a Bookshelf. Check JEI for the recipes available to you.

pages.title: Other Stats
pages.text: At this stage, there are a few basic options for increasing other stats.$(p)you can use Candles to increase $(arcana), Skulls to increase $(quanta), and Amethyst Clusters to increase $(rectification).
